typography.font_family_mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

page_pad.rules: w-full max-w-none px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 2xl:px-12
page_pad.behavior: Fluid width. Do not cap the max-width for the entire page container in an ERP dashboard. Let it expand to 100% of the viewport minus the sidebar. Capping leaves dead whitespace on wide monitors.

card_grid.behavior: NEVER stretch a single card to fill the entire row. When there are few items, they should maintain their natural width (~320px-400px max) and flow left-to-right. On wide screens, increase the number of columns, do NOT stretch the width of individual cards.

dashboard_kpi_grid.behavior: KPI tiles should be compact and dense. On ultrawide monitors, span more columns rather than scaling up into massive tiles.

data_tables.wrapper: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-[16px] border border-[#f1ece4] bg-[#fffdfb] shadow-sm
data_tables.behavior: Data tables MUST span 100% of the available fluid width. Distribute column widths sensibly. Always align numerical data, quantities, and money to the right.

pos_sell_screen.rules: flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-6 h-full min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]
pos_sell_screen.right_pane: w-full lg:w-[400px] xl:w-[480px] shrink-0 border-l border-[#f1ece4]
pos_sell_screen.behavior: The billing counter (cart) MUST be a fixed width on desktop so it doesn't become unreadably wide. The catalog/scanner area takes up the remaining fluid space via flex-1.

setup_forms.wrapper: w-full max-w-4xl bg-[#fffdfb] p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-[16px] shadow-sm border border-[#f1ece4]
setup_forms.behavior: Unlike tables, FORMS SHOULD BE CAPPED. Reading/typing across a 1920px screen is terrible UX. Cap form containers at max-w-3xl or max-w-4xl. Use 2-column CSS grids for inputs.

component_guidelines.cards: Keep cards bounded. Content inside cards should use flex columns to push actions (buttons) to the bottom edge consistently.
component_guidelines.tables: Use subtle alternating row colors (bg-[#fffdfb] and bg-[#faf7f2]) for readability on dense lists. Sticky headers are mandatory for long tables.
component_guidelines.inputs: Inputs should fill their CSS grid cell (w-full). Do not use infinite width inputs.
component_guidelines.buttons: Standardize heights. Never stretch buttons horizontally to 100% of a wide screen unless it's a prominent CTA in a narrow sidebar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor `.page-pad` in all JS files to remove any hardcoded `max-w-7xl` or similar restrictive wrappers. Ensure it uses fluid width logic (`w-full`).

Refactor `.card-grid` heavily. Remove any logic that blindly stretches flex children. Implement `grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,320px),1fr))]` so cards wrap cleanly and maintain correct proportions.
For Outbound/Receive/Stock tables, ensure the parent wrapper has `w-full` and `overflow-x-auto` to handle overflow, while the table spans `w-full` inside it.
For Master/Setup pages, enclose forms inside a `max-w-4xl` container to prevent infinite horizontal stretching of input fields.
For POS/Sell screens, implement a strict flex layout: `flex-1` for the product/scan area and a fixed `w-[400px]` or `w-[450px]` for the cart/billing sidebar.
CRITICAL: DO NOT alter the predefined color palette (Navy #1f2d4d, Rust #c4623f, Paper #faf7f2, Surface #fffdfb, Beige #f1ece4) or the 16px radius.
Ensure monetary values, Ledgers, and IDs strictly use the monospace font stack via `font-mono`.
Implement `data-testid` on all interactive and key informational elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over the 'paper' or 'surface' backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.focus: Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#c4623f] for interactive elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
